units.source_text: 苗子低下头说：“秀男先生，不瞒你说，

en.t: Naeko lowered her head and said, "Mr. Hideo, to tell you the truth,

units.source_text: 前天千重子小姐店里的人把我的和服乃至草屐全都给我送来了，

en.t: the day before yesterday, the people from Miss Chieko's shop brought me everything, from my kimono to my straw sandals,

units.source_text: 可是这些东西，我什么时候才穿得着呢。”

en.t: but when will I ever be able to wear these things?"
